name: Methodology concern
about: Push back on a measurement choice
title: '[methodology] '
labels: methodology
assignees: ''
---

## The claim you're disputing

(Point to the doc + section. E.g., "docs/metrics.md §3.3 claims the
self-enhancement guard sufficiently defangs OpenAI-judging-OpenAI-output.")

## Why you think it's wrong

(A paragraph. Or, ideally, an adversarial test case the current setup misclassifies.)

## What you'd propose instead

(Concrete alternative. "Replace X with Y" is more useful than "X is bad.")

## What experiment would distinguish them

(A scenario where your proposal and the current implementation give different
answers. If you can't construct one, the disagreement may be about taste, so
file as a Discussion instead.)

## References

(Prior art that bears on the question.)
